about: Checks before merging the MI210 rows into the Φ-Bench dataset that no script can decide. status: done | open | failed | not-applicable. blocking: the row is not ready while the item is not done. task null applies to every row. Read by phibench_premerge.py.

items.note: Clear the rows, their reference patches and the vendored code with Omar and the other Φ-Bench owners before merging. The Hugging Face copy is already public (the user's choice, 2026-11-07).
The draft dataset says apache-2.0, unconfirmed. Vendored code under environment/repo/ is from vLLM (Apache-2.0); the task text, grader and patches are ours.

Upstream builds with docker buildx. Our images were built with Enroot by following each Dockerfile step (phibench_enroot.py); every Dockerfile check passed, but no one has run docker buildx on them (no docker group access on the nodes).
scripts/run_task.py passes only NVIDIA GPUs (--gpus all); these tasks need --device /dev/kfd --device /dev/dri. The owners must accept a runner change or a documented manual path.

Our Dockerfile copies tests/verifier-correctness-manifest.json, with ref_speedup, into the image, as upstream's own example lh task does; upstream's README says the in-image copy omits the anchor. Ask the owners which they want.
Upstream anchors are calibrated on NVIDIA H20; ours on AMD MI210. With no hardware column, MI210 is stated in the summary, instruction, task.toml and caveat. The owners decide whether that is enough.
